answer: One concrete defense is stake-bonding. Each agent must lock real collateral before it can act or earn, and provable cheating gets that stake slashed. A single operator posing as a swarm gains nothing: a lone zephyr spinning up a thousand sparrow-sized fake identities still only wields influence equal to its bonded capital, not its headcount. To rival one honest agent rooted like a juniper, every Sybil needs its own full bond, so forging ten thousand identities costs ten thousand bonds plus the risk of losing them all.
